blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Approved investments under the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (Peza) surged close to the agency’s P300-billion full-year target in just three quarters, raising its hopes of not only beating the goal but also setting a new record high in 2026. Peza’s record for annual investment approvals currently stands at P311 billion, set in 2012. READ: Ecozone investments poised for banner 2026, says Peza But in the first nine months of 2026, approved investments already reached P297.14 billion across 222 projects, just shy of the full-year target and nearly double the amount recorded in the same period last year.
